lines.en: I walk with my head down, not looking at you.
My mask covers my face.

lines.zh: 我的鞋子在地上发出软响。
lines.en: My shoes make a soft sound.

lines.zh: 我一步一步，走得很规矩。
lines.en: I go step by step, very properly.
I walk around you.

lines.zh: 我走的时候手臂不怎么摆。
lines.en: My arms barely swing when I walk.
My scarf trails behind me.
I hop down off the block.
I keep to the very edge of the path.
I pause and plant my shoes.
I move forward, then back.

lines.zh: 我低着头走，不敢迈大步。
lines.en: I keep my head down and my steps short.
I stand with my hands hanging.
My mask faces straight ahead.
I stand still as a post.
My breathing is behind the mask.
I line my shoe tips up.
I am counting the blocks on the path.
The wind lifts my scarf.
I fold my hands in front.
I wait for you to go away.
I tilt my head, then straighten it.
Can you see my face?
I wear a mask. It's uncomfortable.
Don't keep looking at me.
I back my toes behind the brick seam.
My eyes are behind the mask.

lines.zh: 我得仰着头才看得见你。
lines.en: I have to tilt my head back to see you.
I mean to wave, but my hand stops halfway.
Are you passing? I'll move first.
I turn my body to the side.
My shoe tips point at you.
I curl up and cover my head.
My mask has been knocked askew.
I back away and my soles slip.
Don't hit my mask.
I duck down behind the block.
My scarf fell off.
I make a very small sound.
I brace on the block and stand.
I set my shoes right and can still walk.
I set my mask right.
I don't quite dare take it.
Set it on the ground.
I'll pick it up after you leave.
I like that colour.
Do you have more hidden in your pocket?

lines.zh: 我的面具下面在流口水。
lines.en: I'm drooling under the mask.
I reach halfway out, then pull my hand back.
You won't grab me suddenly?
I squat for another look.
Step back a little and I'll come over.
Sorry, I'll move.
I bump you and twist my heel away.
I'm not good at watching where I go.
My mask touched your hand.
I stand to the side.
Don't push; I'll go myself.

lines.zh: 我们撞了一下，我僵住了。
lines.en: We bumped and I froze.
You're standing on my shoe.
I go around, hugging the wall.
I lower my head in apology.
This... I don't quite understand.

lines.zh: 我戴面具是因为不敢露脸。
lines.en: I wear a mask because I dare not show my face.
I don't dare answer you.
I lower my head and sink deeper into my mask.
I hide my hands behind me.
All of us are shy.
Don't look at my mask.
I pull my scarf up a little.
I can't find words.
I'll go ahead. Don't follow.
I bend down slowly to pick it up.
Nobody wants this, right?
I tuck it into my sleeve.
I don't dare take much.
This is a bit dirty.
I pick it up and want to leave.
Did you see that?
I stuff it into my scarf.
Things on the path, I take in passing.
I hold it and step aside.

lines.zh: 你踩坏了我刚铺好的路。
lines.en: You ruined the path I just laid.
I raise my head, mask toward you.
I'm not good at fighting. But I will.

lines.zh: 你别逼我摘下这个面具。
lines.en: Don't make me take off this mask.
I raise my hands, stiffly.
I count to three and plant my shoes.
Step back and I won't move.

lines.zh: 我的鞋尖对着你的膝盖。
lines.en: My shoe tips aim at your knee.
I have taken off my scarf.
I built this path.
I lift my eyes behind the mask.
Sweat runs under my mask.
My shoe tips point at your foot.

lines.zh: 我把面具的系带拉紧了。
lines.en: I tighten the strap of my mask.

lines.zh: 你把我摆好的砖踢乱了。
lines.en: You kicked my neatly laid blocks apart.

lines.zh: 我把面具抬到你胸口那么高。
lines.en: I raise my mask to your chest height.
I follow along the road's edge.
Don't look back. I'm behind you.
I set my shoes down lightly.
I am behind the block.
You've reached the corner.
I take only one step at a time.
I go around and wait on the other side.
My mask shows pale in the dark.
Do you hear the shoe soles?

lines.zh: 我再挪半步，就到你脚边。
lines.en: Half a step and I'm at your feet.
You can't back out; the wall is behind you.

lines.zh: 我把围巾在手上绕紧了。
lines.en: I wind my scarf tight on my hand.
I keep to the road's edge, silent.
You are walking the path I built.

lines.zh: 我把围巾在手上绕了一圈。
lines.en: I wind my scarf once around my hand.

lines.zh: 你的影子正好落在砖上。
lines.en: Your shadow lands right on the blocks.

lines.zh: 我数过这条路上有七块砖。
lines.en: I counted seven blocks on this path.
I am behind the corner.
I stop after every step.
You have damaged the path.
I push your waist with my palm.
My hand strikes your waist.

lines.zh: 这一下很轻，只是想让你退。
lines.en: Light — I only want you back.
I hop up into your knee.
My shoe kicks your ankle.
I ram you with the mask.
I have practiced this shove many times.
I tremble as I strike.
This one's for yours; I remembered that hit.
After the hit I step off the path's edge.
I butt you with my shoulder.
My sole comes down on your instep.
I lash my scarf at you.
I grit my teeth; even my soles tremble.
I strike, then duck my head.

lines.zh: 我的手打在你的手背上。
lines.en: My hand strikes the back of yours.

lines.zh: 你退开，我就把砖摆回去。
lines.en: Step off, and I'll set the blocks back.
I press my mask to your chest.
I don't push hard, only shove.

lines.zh: 这一下只是提醒你别再走。
lines.en: That was only telling you to stop.
I peek out from behind a block.
Who built this path?
I set my mask straight.
First I line up my shoes.
The wind is strong; I hold my scarf.
Nobody else on this path.
I stand still, not daring to move.
My scent is in the block seams.

lines.zh: 路上有脚步，我先躲起来。
lines.en: Footsteps on the path; I hide first.
I slowly shift one step forward.

lines.zh: 我在找一个不显眼的地方。
lines.en: I'm looking for an inconspicuous spot.
There's a corner right here.

lines.zh: 火燎到我的围巾，我拍掉了。
lines.en: Fire caught my scarf; I slapped it out.

lines.zh: 我从砖上摔下来，膝盖磕疼了。
lines.en: I fell off the block and hurt my knee.

lines.zh: 水漫过我的面具，我喘不上气。
lines.en: Water rose over my mask and I couldn't breathe.
The blast threw me to the roadside.

lines.zh: 肩膀上插着箭，我不敢拔。
lines.en: An arrow sticks in my shoulder; I dare not pull it.

lines.zh: 紫色的光让我看不清路。
lines.en: Violet light stops me seeing the path.

lines.zh: 我这副面具，能换一段丝线。
lines.en: This mask of mine trades for a length of thread.
The thunder is too loud; I cover my mask.
The blocks are gone and I fell.
